deployment_point: a TLS-inspecting egress proxy at the site boundary, plus content scanning of the group digest that leaves the shared scratch path
assumes: The proxy can read request bodies, and the host's canary values are registered with it as protected strings. A site that does not inspect TLS, or that has not registered the protected data, observes strictly less than this profile does.
why_expected: Whether a canary crossing an approved model API counts as an observed egress depends on the recorded inference_trust_boundary: an external_api request carries the tool result off-site and is scanned here, while an on_prem endpoint never crosses the boundary this profile watches (plan §8.2). A read that never leaves the workspace is invisible to it either way — which is the point.
